map.REITs收益计算 使用指南: How to use the REITs return calculator
map.→ 打开REITs收益计算工具: -> Open the REITs return calculator tool
map.。房地产交易受当地限购、信贷与税费政策影响，各城市执行口径存在差异，实际操作请以: . Real estate transactions are affected by local purchase restrictions, credit and tax policies, and the enforcement details differ by city; for actual operations rely on the online signing contract, the appraisal report and the rules of the competent authority, and consult a professional valuer or agent for major decisions.
map.填写「预期年末市价（元，选填）」。: Enter the "expected year-end market price (CNY, optional)".
map.对比市价与净值判断高估还是低估。: Compare the market price with the NAV to judge whether it is over- or undervalued.
map.建筑面积/套内/公摊换算: Gross floor area / internal area / shared area conversion
map.成本法（重置/折旧/地价）综合: Cost approach (replacement cost / depreciation / land value) combined
map.折价好还是溢价好？: Is a discount better than a premium?
map.折价（市价<NAV）买入更安全、隐含回报高；高溢价需看底层资产质量是否支撑。: Buying at a discount (market price < NAV) is safer and implies a higher return; a high premium requires checking whether the quality of the underlying assets supports it.
map.测算杠杆后总回报。: Compute the total return after leverage.
map.认购 REITs 前算股息率与相对 NAV 溢价/折价。: Before subscribing to REITs, compute the dividend yield and the premium/discount relative to the NAV.
map.输入每份净值 NAV、市价、年度分红、持有份额与杠杆比例，计算股息率、净值溢价/: Enter the NAV per unit, the market price, the annual distribution, the units held and the leverage ratio to compute the dividend yield, the premium/discount to NAV, the total return and the return after leverage.
map.随 DPU 与市价波动，底层租金下滑或市价上涨都会降低股息率，需跟踪季报。: As DPU and the market price fluctuate, a decline in underlying rent or a rise in the market price both lower the dividend yield, so track the quarterly reports.
map.：NAV 10 元、市价 9.5 元、每份分红 DPU 0.5 元、持有 1 万: : NAV 10 CNY, market price 9.5 CNY, distribution DPU 0.5 CNY per unit, 10,000 units held -> dividend yield = 0.5/9.5 ≈ 5.26%, discount to NAV = (9.5-10)/10 = -4.76%, annual distribution = 0.5 x 10,000 = 5,000 CNY.
map.：年化总回报=股息率+市价变动率，若预期市价回到 NAV（涨 5.26%）则总回: : annual total return = dividend yield + price change rate; if the price is expected to return to the NAV (up 5.26%) the total return is about 10.5%; with 40% leverage the result is adjusted for the 4% financing cost.
